---
title: "Tu Bari Sakhi Hai Fatima"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Mir"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Tu Bari Sakhi Hai Fatima
Mohsin-e-Ali Hai Fatima.
Ikhtiyar-e-Kun Ke Bawojood.
Chaki Peesti Hai Fatima.

2
Mustafa Ko Mangna Para.
Tab Kahin Mili Hai Fatima.
Aaye Hain Hasan Bawaqt-e-Zohar.
Asar Parh Rahi Hai Fatima.

3
Waqt Ke Imam Ke Liye.
Aag Par Chali Hai Fatima.
Jaye Ga Jinna Mein Kaise Sheikh.
Dar Pe Hi Khari Hai Fatima.

4
Kya Taqabul Umhat Se.
Maa Rasool Ki Hai Fatima.
Sin Ko Choor Martabay Ko Dekh.
Nooh Se Bari Hai Fatima.

5
La-Illaha Jhomne Laga.
Sajda Kar Rahi Hai Fatima.
 Mir Taig-e-Murtaza Ke Sath.
Arsh Par Pali Hai Fatima.

from pathlib import Path

p = Path('src/data/lyrics/tu-bari-sakhi-hai-fatima-tajpoints-29f3f5f5775aabda6a9b.md')
old = check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---', 2)[2]
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
normalize = lambda s: [line.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
assert normalize(roman) == normalize(old)
for text, nums in [(body, '۱۲۳۴۵'), (roman, '12345')]:
    blocks = text.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 5
    for block, number in zip(blocks, nums):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
print('Verified five matching stanzas of four verses and preserved Roman wording.')

item.text:
Reconstructed all 20 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have five matching four-verse stanzas. Set the direction to right-to-left and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous “Jinna” as `جناں` and “Sin” as `سِن` (age).
